arb.vpnDisclosure_body: FuzeVPN wuxuu isticmaalaa adeegga VPN ee Android (VpnService) si uu u abuuro tunnel la sireeyay oo isku xidha aaladdan iyo serverrada FuzeVPN.
arb.vpnDisclosure_dataBody: Marka VPN-ku firfircoon yahay, socodka internetka ee barnaamijyadaada, cinwaannada meesha loo socdo iyo codsiyada DNS waxay maraan tunnel-kan si xidhiidhkaaga loo jiheeyo, xitaa marka FuzeVPN gadaal ka shaqeynayo.
arb.vpnDisclosure_statusBody: Barnaamijku wuxuu isticmaalaa xaaladda xidhiidhka, muddadiisa iyo xaddiga xogta la wareejiyay si uu u muujiyo xidhiidhkaaga VPN. Waad joojin kartaa goor kasta.
arb.accountRestoration_title: Akoonka si ku meel gaar ah looma heli karo
arb.accountRestoration_message: Fadhigaaga waa la kaydiyay. Isku day mar kale si akoonkaaga loo soo celiyo; halkan waad ka maamuli kartaa xidhiidhka VPN.
arb.session_ending: Fadhiga waa la dhammeynayaa: VPN-ka waa la joojinayaa, waana la nadiifinayaa…
arb.session_stopFailed: Joojinta VPN-ka lama xaqiijin. Isku day mar kale ka hor intaadan mar kale soo gelin.
arb.session_cleanupFailed: VPN-ka waa la joojiyay, laakiin ka saarista fadhiga lama xaqiijin. Isku day nadiifinta mar kale.
arb.startup: FuzeVPN si ammaan ah ayaa loo diyaarinayaa…
arb.auth_keysLocal: Furayaasha gaarka ah ee VPN-kaaga waxay ku sii jiraan aaladdan.
arb.form_passwordMin: 8–72 bayt oo UTF-8 ah. Xarfaha qaarkood waxay isticmaalaan in ka badan hal bayt.
arb.auth_consentRequired: Oggolaanshahaaga ayaa loo baahan yahay si akoon loo abuuro.
arb.validation_email: Geli cinwaan iimayl oo sax ah.
arb.validation_password: Erayga sirta wuu gaaban yahay: ugu yaraan 8 bayt oo UTF-8 ah.
arb.validation_passwordTooLong: Erayga sirta wuu dheer yahay: ugu badnaan 72 bayt oo UTF-8 ah.
arb.validation_phone: Isticmaal qaabka caalamiga ah, tusaale ahaan +33612345678.
arb.validation_country: Isticmaal koodh dal oo laba xaraf ah, tusaale ahaan FR.
arb.passwordReset_description: Geli cinwaanka iimaylka ee akoonkaaga si aad u codsato xiriir lagu dib u dejiyo erayga sirta.
arb.connection_prepare: Diyaar ma u tahay inaad ku xidhanto?
arb.connection_lastHandshake: Isweydaarsiga ammaanka ah ee ugu dambeeyay
arb.verification_message: Xaqiiji cinwaanka iimaylkaaga si aad VPN-ka ugu isticmaasho taleefankan.
arb.migration_blocked: Beddelka goobta wuxuu u baahan yahay faragelin dhinaca server-ka ah. Mar dambe isku day ama la xiriir taageerada.
arb.migration_resume: Dib u sii wad beddelka goobta
arb.status_authorizingDetail: Aqbal codsiga Android si VPN-ka loo oggolaado.
arb.status_preparingDetail: Xidhiidhkaaga ammaanka ah waa la diyaarinayaa.
arb.status_reconnectingDetail: Xidhiidhku wuu go’ay. VPN-ku wuxuu isku dayayaa inuu dib ku xidhmo.
arb.status_errorDetail: Xidhiidhka VPN lama xaqiijin. Isku day mar kale.
arb.status_idleDetail: Ku xidh VPN-ka si aad xidhiidhkaaga u ilaaliso.
arb.trust_note: Marka barnaamijka la xidho, VPN-ku ma joogsado. Si aad u joojiso, isticmaal “Jooji”.
arb.locations_none: Hadda ma jiraan goobo la heli karo.
arb.locations_lockedTunnel: Jooji VPN-ka si aad goobta u beddesho.
arb.devices_empty: Weli ma jirto aalad VPN ah oo diiwaangashan.
arb.devices_firstConnection: Taleefankaaga waa la dari doonaa marka ugu horreysa ee aad ku xidhanto.
arb.settings_subtitle: Doorashooyinkaaga iyo akoonkaaga, oo dhan hal meel.
arb.settings_languageDescription: Luqadda aad dooratay waxaa sidoo kale loo isticmaalaa ogeysiisyada VPN-ka.
arb.settings_licensesLegalese: Koodhka isha ee barnaamijka iyo qaybihiisa MPL-2.0 ah: {url}
arb.settings_background: VPN-ku wuu sii shaqeynayaa marka aad barnaamijka ka baxdo. Si aad u joojiso, qaybta Xidhiidh ka isticmaal “Jooji”.
arb.dialog_removeCurrent: Taleefankan wuu ka go’i doonaa VPN-ka wuuna waayi doonaa gelitaanka. Xogta xidhiidhkiisa VPN waa la tirtiri doonaa marka server-ku xaqiijiyo.
arb.dialog_removeOther: Gelitaanka VPN ee “{name}” waa la ka qaadi doonaa. Tan dib looma noqon karo.
arb.dialog_signOutMessage: VPN-ku wuu joogsan doonaa, waxaadna u baahan doontaa inaad mar kale soo gasho. Furayaasha VPN-ka ee la sireeyay waxay ku sii jiri doonaan taleefankan xidhiidhkaaga xiga.
arb.notice_sessionExpired_message: Fadhigaagu wuu dhacay. Mar kale soo gal.
arb.notice_invalidCredentials_message: Cinwaanka iimaylka ama erayga sirta ma sax aha.
arb.notice_emailVerification_title: Xaqiijinta iimaylka ayaa loo baahan yahay
arb.notice_emailVerification_message: Xaqiiji cinwaanka iimaylkaaga ka hor intaadan aalad VPN ah ku darin.
arb.notice_deviceLimit_message: Ka saar aalad hadda jirta ka hor intaadan mid kale ku darin.
arb.notice_identityRenewal_title: Aqoonsiga VPN waa in la cusboonaysiiyaa
arb.notice_identityRenewal_message: Aqoonsigan waa la tirtiray. Samee aqoonsi cusub oo maxalli ah.
arb.notice_migrationPending_message: Beddel goob ayaa hore u socda.
arb.notice_migrationBlocked_message: Beddelka goobta wuxuu u baahan yahay faragelin dhinaca server-ka ah. Mar dambe isku day ama la xiriir taageerada.
arb.notice_targetUnavailable_title: Server-ka si ku meel gaar ah looma heli karo
arb.notice_targetUnavailable_message: Server-kan si ku meel gaar ah looma heli karo.
arb.notice_networkUnavailable_message: Hubi xidhiidhkaaga, kadibna isku day mar kale.
arb.notice_permissionDenied_message: Mar kale bilow xidhiidhka, kadibna aqbal codsiga oggolaanshaha Android.
arb.notice_wireguardTimeout_message: Xidhiidhka WireGuard waqti badan ayuu qaatay. Isku day mar kale ama dooro goob kale.
arb.notice_tlsFailed_title: Xidhiidhka ammaanka ah waa la diiday
arb.notice_tlsFailed_message: Server-ku ma aqbalin xidhiidhka OpenVPN. Isku day mar kale. Haddii dhibaatadu sii socoto, samee baaritaan.
arb.notice_tunRejected_message: Android wuxuu diiday habaynta shabakadda ee OpenVPN uu codsaday.
arb.notice_openvpnStart_message: Mishiinka OpenVPN ma dhammaystiri karin bilaabidda. Isku day mar kale. Haddii dhibaatadu sii socoto, la xiriir taageerada.
arb.notice_generic_message: Khalad ayaa dhacay. Mar dambe isku day.

arb.notice_permissionRequestInProgress_title: Codsiga oggolaanshaha horeba waa furan yahay
arb.notice_permissionRequestInProgress_messa: Codsiga oggolaanshaha VPN ee Android hadda waa soo muuqdaa. Dhammaystir ka hor intaadan mar kale isku dayin.
arb.notice_permissionRequestInterrupted_mess: Shaashadda oggolaanshaha VPN waa la xidhay ka hor intaanu barnaamijku jawaab helin.
arb.notice_openvpnProofMissing_message: Xidhiidhka OpenVPN lama xaqiijin karin. Amni darteed waa la joojiyay. Isku day mar kale.
arb.openvpnCleanup_working: Profiilka OpenVPN ee la baabi’iyay waa la joojinayaa oo la tirtirayaa…
arb.openvpnCleanup_stopFailed: Joojinta OpenVPN lama xaqiijin. Isku day mar kale ka hor intaadan abuurin profiil cusub.
arb.openvpnCleanup_cleanupFailed: Profiilka OpenVPN ee la baabi’iyay gebi ahaanba lama tirtiri karin. Isku day nadiifinta mar kale.
arb.openvpnCleanup_complete: Profiilka OpenVPN ee la baabi’iyay waa la tirtiray. Taabo “Ku xidh” si aad mid cusub u abuurto.
arb.network_ipv4Fallback: IPv6 si ku meel gaar ah looma heli karo. Diyaarintu waxay ku sii socotaa IPv4.
arb.network_rejectedMessage: Habaynta tunnel-ka ma dhammaystirna ama ma waafaqsana cinwaannada la oggolaaday. Barnaamijka ka isku day mar kale.
arb.network_unreadableTitle: Habaynta maxalliga ah lama akhriyi karo
arb.network_unreadableMessage: Habaynta shabakadda OpenVPN ee la kaydiyay lama isticmaali karo. Barnaamijka ka dib ku xidh si aad u cusboonaysiiso.
arb.protection_subtitle: Xannib gelitaanka toos ah ee internetka haddii VPN-ku go’o.
arb.protection_alwaysOnOnly: “VPN had iyo jeer” waa la shiday; shid xannibaadda xidhiidhada aan VPN lahayn
arb.protection_dialogMessage: Android ayaa maamula “VPN had iyo jeer” iyo xannibidda xidhiidhada ka baxsan VPN-ka. Hubi in FuzeVPN la doortay, kadibna dejinta nidaamka ka shid xannibaadda.
arb.session_systemProtectionNote: Haddii Android weli xannibayo socodka ka baxsan VPN-ka, fur dejinta nidaamka si aad u hubiso ama u beddesho ilaalintan.
arb.diagnostics_automaticDescription: La wadaag warbixin farsamo oo yar marka khalad muhiim ah dhaco.
arb.diagnostics_privacy: Warbixinnada la diro waxay ku xiran yihiin akoonka aad soo gashay, waxaana la hayaa 30 maalmood. Kuma jiraan taariikhda bogagga aad booqatay, erayada sirta ah ama furayaasha VPN.
arb.diagnostics_localDescription: Samee warbixin ku saabsan xaaladda barnaamijka iyo VPN-ka. Xidhiidhkaaga lama beddelayo.
arb.diagnostics_sendHint: Sanduuqan ha calaamadin si warbixinta aaladdan loogu hayo.
arb.diagnostics_signedOut: Si aad warbixin u dirto, soo gal akoonkaaga.
arb.diagnostics_localLifetime: Ku kaydi warbixintan taleefankaaga si aad ugu hayso ka dib marka aad barnaamijka xidho.
arb.diagnostics_prepared: Warbixinta waxay diyaar ku tahay aaladdan
arb.diagnostics_queued: Warbixinta waxay sugaysaa in la diro
arb.diagnostics_failed: Dirista way guuldareysatay. Warbixintaada maxalliga ah weli way diyaar tahay.
arb.diagnostics_preparationFailed: Warbixinta baaritaanka lama diyaarin karin. Isku day mar kale.
arb.diagnostics_authenticationRequired: Mar kale soo gal si aad warbixinta u dirto.
arb.diagnostics_exportFailed: Kaydintu way guuldareysatay. Mar kale isku day warbixinta maxalliga ah.
arb.diagnostics_preferenceFailed: Dejintan lama kaydin karin. Isku day mar kale.

arb.locations_favoriteSaveFailed: Goobta la jecel yahay lama kaydin karin. Isku day mar kale.

arb.locations_emptyHint: Cusboonaysii liiska si aad mar kale isku daydo.
arb.settings_personalization: Ka dhig mid adiga kuu gaar ah

arb.notice_preferenceSave_message: Doorashadaada hadda waa la dabaqay, laakiin lama kaydin karin. Isku day mar kale si ay u sii jirto marka barnaamijka la xidho.
arb.connection_androidDisconnectHint: Haddii Android uu VPN-ka firfircoon hayo, ka demi “VPN had iyo jeer” dejinta furmaysa.
arb.protection_guideWhy: Ilaalintan waxay ka hortagtaa barnaamijyada inay si toos ah u isticmaalaan internetka haddii VPN-ku go’o. Waxaa lagu habeeyaa gudaha Android.
arb.protection_guideAlwaysOn: Android wuxuu ka dhigaa adeegga VPN mid shaqeynaya, wuuna dib u bilaabi karaa marka taleefanka dib loo bilaabo.
arb.protection_guideBlock: Dejintan waxay ka hortagtaa in socodka xogta VPN-ka ka baxsado, xitaa marka xidhiidhku go’o.
arb.protection_guideWarning: Marka xannibaaddan la shido, internetka lama isticmaali karo ilaa VPN-ka lagu xidho.
arb.protection_guideStep1: Badhanka hoose ku fur dejinta VPN ee Android.
arb.protection_guideStep2: Astaanta giirka ee ku xigta FuzeVPN ku fur doorashooyinka.
arb.protection_guideStep3: Shid “VPN had iyo jeer”, kadibna “Xannib xidhiidhada aan VPN lahayn”, haddii doorashooyinkaasi jiraan.
arb.protection_guideManufacturers: Magacyadu way kala duwan yihiin taleefan ilaa taleefan. Haddii loo baahdo, gudaha Dejinta ka raadi VPN, badanaaba hoosta Shabakadda & internetka.
arb.protection_guideDisable: Isla dejintaas, demi “Xannib xidhiidhada aan VPN lahayn” si aad internetka ugu isticmaasho adigoo aan VPN isticmaalin. Sidoo kale demi “VPN had iyo jeer” haddii aadan mar dambe rabin in Android uu dib u bilaabo.
arb.protection_guideManual: Dejintan waxaad ku doortaa gudaha Android. FuzeVPN kuuma beddelo.
arb.locations_changeActive: VPN-ku wuu joogsan doonaa, kadibna wuxuu isku dayi doonaa inuu ku xidhmo {name}.
arb.locations_changeIdle: VPN-ku wuxuu isku dayi doonaa inuu ku xidhmo {name}.
arb.locations_changeBusy: Beddel ayaa socda. Sug ka hor intaadan dooran goob kale.
arb.locations_noCompatibleServer: Server la waafaqsan lama heli karo.
arb.externalLink_failed: Xiriirkan lama furi karo. Waad koobiyeyn kartaa oo browser-kaaga ku furi kartaa.
arb.externalLink_copyFailed: Xiriirka lama koobiyeyn karo. Dooro cinwaanka hoose.
arb.billing_choosePlan: Dooro qorshe si aad u sii waddo.
arb.billing_deleteAccountWarning: Haddii aad leedahay isdiiwaangelin Google Play ah, tirtirista akoonkaaga FuzeVPN ma joojinayso cusboonaysiinteeda. Cusboonaysiinta si gooni ah ugu maamul ama ku jooji Google Play.
arb.billing_unavailable: Hadda ma jiraan qorshayaal la heli karo. Mar dambe isku day.
arb.billing_comingSoon: Isdiiwaangelinnada dhawaan ayaa la heli doonaa.
arb.billing_priceDisclosure: Qiimaha waxaa bixiya Google Play. Wadarta ugu dambeysa iyo canshuuraha khuseeya waa la xaqiijiyaa ka hor intaadan xaqiijin.
arb.billing_renewalMonthly: Waxaa si toos ah loo cusboonaysiiyaa bil kasta ilaa la joojiyo. Goor kasta waxaad ka joojin kartaa isdiiwaangelinnada Google Play.
arb.billing_renewalYearly: Waxaa si toos ah loo cusboonaysiiyaa sannad kasta ilaa la joojiyo. Goor kasta waxaad ka joojin kartaa isdiiwaangelinnada Google Play.
arb.billing_webManaged: Isdiiwaangelintaada waxaa lagu maamulaa mareegta FuzeVPN.
arb.billing_playOnHold: Isdiiwaangelintaada Google Play waa la hakiyay ama waxay sugaysaa lacag bixin. Fur “Maamul isdiiwaangelinta” si aad ugu hagaajiso Google Play.
arb.billing_playReceiptUnlinked: Akoonkan Google Play horeba wuxuu leeyahay isdiiwaangelin Fuze Premium ah oo aan u firfircoonayn akoonkan FuzeVPN. Fur “Maamul isdiiwaangelinta” si aad ugu eegto Google Play.
arb.billing_pending: Lacag bixinta waa la sugayaa. Gelitaankaaga waa la hawlgelin doonaa marka la xaqiijiyo.
arb.billing_cancelled: Iibsiga waa la joojiyay. Isdiiwaangelin cusub lama hawlgelin.
arb.billing_success: Isdiiwaangelinta waa la hawlgeliyay. Gelitaankaaga Premium waa diyaar.
